store.RecordGap keys task.gap_found on task, doc and anchor only. A second gap with a different reason on the same section is treated as a retry: nothing is recorded and the CLI prints 'gap already recorded'. Seen on WL-1350, where the OpenAPI table-schema gap for WL-PLAN-166 was lost.

Fix: add a short hash of the trimmed reason to the external id, so an identical retry still deduplicates and a distinct reason is recorded. Test: two reasons on one anchor both insert; the same reason twice inserts once.
